research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: TScan Therapeutics is engaged in the development of immunotherapy treatments for cancer, focusing on immunogenic peptides and binding proteins. They are researching MAGEA and PRAME immunogenic peptides, which are recognized by specific binding proteins, and are exploring their therapeutic uses. Additionally, TScan is developing multiplex T cell receptor compositions and combination therapies, which involve T cell receptors that can bind to specific antigens. These efforts highlight TScan's commitment to advancing cancer immunotherapy through innovative peptide and protein-based approaches.

overview_description.description: TScan is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of T-cell receptor (TCR) engineered T cell therapies (TCR-T) for the treatment of patients with cancer. The company’s lead liquid tumor TCR-T therapy candidates, TSC-100 and TSC-101, are in development for the treatment of patients with hematologic malignancies to eliminate residual leukemia and prevent relapse after hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. The company is also developing multiplexed TCR-T therapy candidates for the treatment of various solid tumors.

product.name: TSC-100
product.description: A TCR-T therapy targeting HA-1 antigen for treating hematologic malignancies in HLA-A*02:01-positive patients undergoing allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplant.

product.name: TSC-101
product.description: A TCR-T therapy targeting HA-2 antigen for hematologic malignancies in HLA-A*02:01-positive patients undergoing allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplant.

product.name: TSC-200 (T-Plex)
product.description: A multiplexed TCR-T therapy targeting HPV16 antigen for treating various solid tumors in HLA-A*02:01 and HLA-C*07:02 positive patients.

product.name: SafetyScan
product.description: A screening technology to identify and eliminate TCR candidates with potential off-target toxicities by detecting cross-reactivity with proteins in critical organs.

product.name: T-Integrate Cell Engineering
product.description: A non-viral transposon-based manufacturing platform for TCR-T therapies enabling multiplexing and functional enhancements in T cells.
